title: 1835 by night: lamp-lit windows, the lighthouse lit, a gate lantern
items: Set Time of day to dusk or night in 1835 and the town's and the fort's windows glow with candle and oil-lamp light, most in the evening and only a few in the small hours.
The lighthouse at the river mouth shows its light from dusk to dawn.
A lantern hangs outside the fort's south gate by the guard house.
